name: The 77 Bank, Ltd.
summary: The 77 Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the banking products and services to corporate and individual customers in Japan. The company offers corporate bond trusteeship; agency; debt guarantees; payment acceptance; over-the-counter sales of government bonds and other public bonds; investment trusts; insurance products; credit guarantee services, credit card, financial instrument trading, research and development, consulting, fund management, personnel placement services, insurance sales services, investment services, etc. The company was founded in 1878 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.
